title: Nourishing Silky Thai Chicken Curry
description: A sour and silky Thai chicken curry featuring red curry paste and dashi extract, perfect for a post-workout meal, and friendly for those who avoid onion and garlic.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the red curry paste to cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside to rest.
Add the dashi extract, fish sauce, and lime juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the sliced bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the curry sauce.
Season the curry with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot over rice or noodles.
